pendingWork.description: Repair the k8s permission seeds the newly shared menu-contract sensor exposed
pendingWork.result: v0.18.2 shares frontend/scripts/check-menu-contract.mjs with consumers, and on its first run over the ops tree it rejected the k8s module: k8s_seed.go built its permission menu seeds inside init() with titleKey := strings.ReplaceAll(item.perm, ":", ".") + ".permission", which the parser cannot resolve to a constant, and the resulting runtime key spelling (business.k8s.cluster.sync.permission) matched no i18n catalogue. Fixed by removing the init() derivation and unrolling 20 static F menuSeed entries plus 40 zh-CN/en-US permission i18nSeed rows on canonical consts, adding the four missing k8sServicePerm* consts, declaring the 16 missing permission strings in frontend/src/modules/business/k8s/index.ts and adding their 20 title translations to the business v12locales JSON. The sensor now passes with the payload above, and k8s module behaviour (bindAdminPermission, seeded menu set) is unchanged.

pendingWork.description: Stop the deterministic rebuild from deleting the ops-only gorm gate and from dropping two hand-added i18n keys
pendingWork.result: The rebuild plan showed scripts/check-gorm-sql-literal.mjs and tests/scripts/check-gorm-sql-literal.test.mjs were undeclared repositoryOverlayPaths, so a clean rebuild would have deleted them and dropped their package.json scripts. Both paths are now declared in business-overlay.json and both script names added to opsOnlyScripts in scripts/business-overlay/rebuild-from-base.mjs; a follow-up dry rebuild re-derived 789 declared/generated files with no deletion. Separately, business.observability.monitoring.field.endpointPlaceholder and ...urlPlaceholder existed only in the generated resources/business/*.ts files, so they would have vanished on rebuild; both are now in frontend/src/modules/business/v12locales/{zh-CN,en-US}.json.

notes: v0.18.2 is a patch release on top of the 13-wave simplification minor. Base commit a44ae4e0 is the squash merge of base PR #479, the tag object 2e32bd46 is annotated, and all four release assets were re-hashed locally after materialization and matched both the root lock and their published .sha256 sidecars (tgz c01ebbc1..., repo.tar c1360fb1...). Release Gate run 41146688290 succeeded on the tagged commit; Foundation Release Verify run 41153048213 succeeded after being dispatched manually, because GitHub suppresses release: published events for releases published with GITHUB_TOKEN, so the tag-triggered fan-out never fired. The consumer-relevant change in this release is the shared menu-contract sensor: v0.18.2 adds frontend/scripts/check-menu-contract.mjs to sharedPaths (backend 4 / frontend 47 / docs 2 = 53), wires it into the frontend prebuild and ships tests/scripts/check-menu-contract.test.mjs. That sensor immediately exposed runtime-derived k8s permission title keys that had never been validated; the consumer fix is recorded in pendingWork. Two pre-existing rebuild defects (undeclared gorm gate scripts, i18n keys only present in generated files) were repaired in the same pass so the next rebuild is lossless.
